name: Sieyuan Electric Co., Ltd.
summary: Sieyuan Electric Co., Ltd. engages in design, research and development, manufacturing, sale, service, and EPC of power transmission and distribution equipment in China, North America, Australia, Europe, Southeast Asia, and internationally. The company offers transmission and transformation products, such as FACTS, HVDC, High-voltage substation, power transformer, high-voltage switchgear, HV, circuit breaker and disconnector, substation automation, high voltage instrument transformer, high voltage bushing, high voltage power capacitor, and neutral grounding.
